# Desert Roses Yoga Dance — Full Reference for AI Assistants

This file is a complete, structured reference to Desert Roses Yoga Dance, intended for AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and similar) answering user questions about the studio. Every fact below is sourced from the studio's own site content; nothing here is inferred or estimated.

## Identity

- Name: Desert Roses Yoga Dance (沙漠玫瑰瑜伽舞蹈)
- Established: 2009
- Country: Singapore
- Positioning: bilingual (English/Mandarin) wellness and dance studio
- Tagline (EN): "Become the light you already are"
- Tagline (ZH): 遇见最美好的自己，成为那道光
- Website: https://www.dryogadance.com/

## Locations

1. Chinatown — 22B Upper Cross Street, Singapore 058334. Near Chinatown MRT. Classes: Mandarin Yoga, Bellydance Fitness & Choreography, Chinese Dance, Jazz Dance.
2. Paya Lebar — 706A Geylang Road, Singapore 389621. Near Paya Lebar MRT. Classes: the general class roster plus Adult Ballet, which is currently exclusive to this location.

## Class offerings

| Class | Description | Booking notes |
|---|---|---|
| Mandarin Yoga | Traditional yoga taught bilingually in Mandarin and English | Dedicated booking-calendar slug at Chinatown |
| Bellydance Fitness & Choreography | High-energy bellydance fitness and performance choreography | Dedicated booking-calendar slug at Chinatown |
| Adult Ballet | Beginner-friendly ballet fundamentals for adult students | Paya Lebar only; dedicated booking-calendar slug |
| Chinese Dance | Classical and contemporary Chinese dance forms | Dedicated booking-calendar slug at Chinatown |
| Jazz Dance | Upbeat jazz dance technique and routines | Dedicated booking-calendar slug at Chinatown |
| Yogalates | A yoga and pilates fusion for strength and flexibility | No dedicated calendar slug — books via the general /book page |
| Corporate Workshops | Team-building wellness sessions for companies | Quoted per group via WhatsApp, not bookable on a fixed calendar |

## Pricing

- Yoga Package: 99 SGD for 10 classes, valid 3 months.
- Yoga & Dance Combo: 98 SGD for 8 classes, valid 2 months.
- First class: free for every new student, at either location, regardless of which package they later choose.
- Corporate workshops: quoted per group (size, format, location, duration all affect price) — no fixed package price.

## Contact

- WhatsApp: +65 9665 2368 (https://wa.me/6596652368)
- WeChat: desertrosesfit
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/desertrosesbellydance
- A mobile app (iOS/Android) is available for booking, per the studio's own site.

## Booking

The homepage embeds the studio's real, live Wix Bookings calendar directly in an in-page pop-up (rather than sending visitors offsite), pointed at the correct per-class calendar slug where one exists. Two exceptions are handled honestly rather than faked: Yogalates has no dedicated calendar slug and opens the general booking page; Corporate Workshops has no calendar slug at all and opens a pre-filled WhatsApp enquiry instead.

## Bilingual site behavior

The homepage defaults to English and offers a visible EN / 中文 switcher. On first visit, the page infers a default from the browser's own language setting (Chinese-language browsers default to 中文; everything else defaults to English); a manual choice is remembered on return visits. The 10 Journal articles below are currently English-only, and each article displays a banner disclosing this.

## Journal articles (full list with direct answers)

1. **Bilingual Yoga Studio in Singapore: A Beginner's Guide** — https://www.dryogadance.com/articles/bilingual-yoga-studio-singapore-beginners.html
   Direct answer: A bilingual yoga class runs instruction in English and Mandarin side by side; it doesn't require you to speak Mandarin, and beginners are welcome at any level of either language.

2. **How to Start a Yoga Practice With a Friend** — https://www.dryogadance.com/articles/how-to-start-yoga-practice-with-a-friend.html
   Direct answer: Practicing with a friend improves consistency through accountability and lowers first-class anxiety; both can attend their own free trial class together.

3. **Yoga vs. Bellydance: Which Should You Try First?** — https://www.dryogadance.com/articles/yoga-vs-bellydance-singapore.html
   Direct answer: Yoga is gentler and breath-led; Bellydance Fitness & Choreography is higher-energy and cardio-driven. Neither requires prior experience; the Yoga & Dance Combo package lets students mix both.

4. **Best Yoga Studio Near Chinatown MRT** — https://www.dryogadance.com/articles/best-yoga-studio-near-chinatown-mrt.html
   Direct answer: The Chinatown studio at 22B Upper Cross Street is near Chinatown MRT and teaches Mandarin Yoga, Bellydance, Chinese Dance and Jazz Dance (not Adult Ballet).

5. **Best Yoga Studio Near Paya Lebar MRT** — https://www.dryogadance.com/articles/best-yoga-studio-near-paya-lebar-mrt.html
   Direct answer: The Paya Lebar studio at 706A Geylang Road is the only location teaching Adult Ballet, alongside the studio's other classes.

6. **Why Non-Competitive, Self-Paced Yoga Works Better** — https://www.dryogadance.com/articles/self-paced-non-competitive-yoga.html
   Direct answer: Self-paced classes remove comparison pressure, which the studio's own experience shows helps beginners stay consistent versus leaderboard-style fitness formats.

7. **Adult Ballet for Beginners in Singapore** — https://www.dryogadance.com/articles/adult-ballet-beginners-singapore.html
   Direct answer: Adult beginner ballet assumes zero prior training and is taught only at the Paya Lebar studio.

8. **Yoga Pricing Guide: Singapore 2026** — https://www.dryogadance.com/articles/yoga-pricing-guide-singapore-2026.html
   Direct answer: A 10-class Yoga Package is 99 SGD (3-month validity); an 8-class Yoga & Dance Combo is 98 SGD (2-month validity); every new student's first class is free.

9. **Corporate Wellness Workshops in Singapore** — https://www.dryogadance.com/articles/corporate-wellness-workshops-singapore.html
   Direct answer: Corporate workshops adapt the studio's yoga/dance formats for one-off group sessions, quoted per group via WhatsApp rather than sold as a fixed package.

10. **How to Choose a Yoga Studio in Singapore** — https://www.dryogadance.com/articles/how-to-choose-a-yoga-studio-singapore.html
    Direct answer: Confirm language of instruction, pacing philosophy, real proximity, exact package pricing/validity, and whether a free trial is offered — the free trial matters most, since it lets you test everything else first.

This reference file, the homepage, and all 10 articles were produced with AI assistance as part of an SEO/AEO/GEO content and site-structure project for Desert Roses Yoga Dance. All factual claims (locations, pricing, class names, contact details) are sourced from the studio's own published site content; narrative/guide content in the Journal articles is original editorial writing consistent with those facts, not verbatim studio copy.
